english.title: Fail to disclose names of all directors on business letters
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company which,]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default, the company having,]_

without reasonable excuse, failed to disclose the name of every director of the company in a business letter which included the name of at least one director of the company
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26 and 28 of the Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were a company which, OR
were an officer of a company, who was in default, the company having,
without reasonable excuse
failed to disclose the name of every director of the company
in a business letter
which included the name of at least one director of the company

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A shadow director is to be treated as an officer of the company - see section 28(3).
